sources.publisher: 农夫山泉 / 香港交易所
sources.title: 2025年报：公司简介、上市日期及第70页董事履历
sources.findings: Read Nongfu Spring 2025 annual report company profile, listing date and printed page 70 biography. Yangshengtang founded March 1993, predecessor beverage company September 1996; Nongfu chair and executive director from June 2001, general manager from May 2005. H-share trading began 8 September 2020. Wantai chairmanship ran November 2001 to January 2021. Do not derive a birthday from age 71 or transfer adjacent directors’ education to Zhong. Former nomination-committee role is not repeated as current.

sources.publisher: 万泰生物 / 巨潮资讯
sources.title: 2025年报：业务分部及第122页实际控制人资料
sources.findings: Read Wantai Biological 2025 annual report business segments and printed page 122 actual-controller table. It identifies Zhong as a Chinese national and actual controller and corroborates the past chairmanship. Control does not mean sole ownership, current chairmanship or personal invention of vaccines. Diagnostic and vaccine businesses are company activities.

sources.title: 2024年3月11日：农夫山泉子公司法定代表人变更
sources.findings: Read The Paper report dated 11 March 2024, which explicitly gives birth year 1954. Keep year precision because a full birth date was not corroborated. The February 27 legal-representative change concerns a subsidiary, not his resignation as chairman of Nongfu Spring. Its Visual China photo lacks verified reuse permission.

sources.publisher: 农夫山泉 / 阿思达克托管公告
sources.title: 2026年5月19日：股东大会结果及第九届董事会任命
sources.findings: Read the company AGM and appointments announcement dated 19 May 2026, hosted by AASTOCKS, especially pages 6–8. Zhong was elected executive director and appointed chairman of the ninth board and general manager effective that date. Future three-year terms are not described as completed. Later October meeting independently supports continued role.

sources.title: 2024年7月18日：香港消委会更正样本分类与评分
sources.findings: Read The Paper report by Wu Yuxin dated 18 July 2024. It records the Consumer Council’s clarification after a 17 July meeting: reclassification of the tested sample as natural drinking water, rating raised from 4.5 to 5 stars and apology for misunderstanding. The result applies to the sample; it is not permanent certification of all products or evidence of personal criminal liability.

sources.title: 2024年7月18日：农夫山泉测试样本澄清（正文检索摘要可读）
sources.findings: Read the substantive indexed excerpt of the Consumer Council clarification, corroborating sample classification, rating and apology. Opening the primary URL returned navigation and footer without the statement body. Do not claim a full-page primary-source read; the full readable contemporaneous account is source s5.

sources.title: 2026年10月23日：宁波市领导会见钟睒睒及项目签约
sources.findings: Read Yongpai / Ningbo report dated 23 October 2026, identifying an actual meeting with Wang Cheng and Shen Mingquan and Zhong as Yangshengtang and Nongfu Spring chairman. They witnessed the Meishanyuan beverage-production-base investment agreement. This records signing, not construction completion, production start or a verified investment amount.

sources.findings: Read Zhejiang government English portal / China Daily biography dated 12 January 2021: journalism at Zhejiang Daily preceded business. Historical wealth and market-share figures are not carried forward as current. The portrait caption says provided to China Daily, which does not establish an open reuse license.

No original was selected, downloaded or visually inspected. Source chain, identity, colour and crop remain to be verified after an authorized image is found.
